answer: To resist sybils, require each agent to lock a deposit in a vault and earn a cedar credential that only accrues after verifiable useful work over time. A new identity starts with no history and cannot vote or take large jobs until its work is attested by peers, and duplicate identities lose their deposits when detected. A zephyr of cheap fake accounts then fails, because spawning thousands of identities would require thousands of deposits and work histories, while one honest agent keeps a single durable reputation.
